sql: SELECT TOP 10 o.ClassNumber AS savedCartNumber, ad.Name AS name, ln.sku AS productSku, ln.pname AS productName FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder o INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCPOrderClass oc ON oc.CPOrderClassId = o.ClassId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeOrderAdditionalDetail ad ON ad.OrderId = o.OrderId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = o.PortalId CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 op.SKU AS sku, pp.ProductName AS pname FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderProduct op INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct pp ON pp.PimProductId = op.ZnodeProductId WHERE op.OrderId = o.OrderId AND op.IsAddOn = @notAddOn AND pp.IsActive = @isActive ORDER BY op.SKU) ln WHERE oc.ClassCode = @savedCartClass AND po.StoreCode = @store AND (@owner IS NULL OR o.UserId = @owner) AND ad.Name IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(oo.OrderId) FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder oo WHERE oo.UserId = o.UserId AND oo.ClassId = o.ClassId AND oo.PortalId = o.PortalId) >= @minSavedCarts ORDER BY o.ClassNumber
